description_en: Calls UpdateAppVersion to update the configuration of an application upgrade version
description_zh: 调用UpdateAppVersion更新应用升级版本中的各项信息配置
name: UpdateAppVersion

parameters.help_en: The version blacklist. Separate multiple version codes with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 版本黑名单，versioncode英文逗号拼接
parameters.name: black_version_list

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the server is allowed to return this application version when the application does not exist on the client
parameters.help_zh: 当客户端不存在该应用时，服务端是否允许返回该应用版本
parameters.name: is_allow_new_install

parameters.help_en: The project ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The application ID. Specifies the application to upgrade
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID，表示要针对哪个应用进行升级
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The application version number
parameters.name: app_version

parameters.help_en: The version code of the application
parameters.name: version_code

parameters.help_en: The installation method of the application upgrade package. Valid values: auto / customize
parameters.help_zh: 应用升级包安装方式。取值：auto / customize
parameters.name: install_type

parameters.help_en: The remarks for the version
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to force an upgrade. Valid values: Y and N
parameters.name: is_force_upgrade

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to perform a silent upgrade. Valid values: Y and N
parameters.name: is_silent_upgrade

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether a restart is required. Valid values: Y and N
parameters.name: is_need_restart

parameters.help_en: The URL of the upgrade package
parameters.name: package_url

parameters.help_en: The release notes for the version
parameters.name: release_note

parameters.help_en: The version whitelist. Separate multiple version codes with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 版本白名单，versioncode英文逗号拼接
parameters.name: white_version_list

parameters.help_en:
The restart type after the application installation is complete. Valid values:

system: system restart.
app: application restart
parameters.help_zh:
应用安装完成后的重启类型。取值：

system：表示系统重启
app：表示应用重启
parameters.name: restart_type

parameters.help_en:
The type of application restart when restartType is set to application restart. Valid values:

service: Service restart.
activity: Activity restart
parameters.help_zh:
如果restartType为应用重启，则这个字段表示应用重启的类型。

service：表示Service重启
activity：表示Activity重启
parameters.name: restart_app_type

parameters.help_en: The restart parameters that can be specified by the server when the application restarts
parameters.help_zh: 应用重启时可以由服务端指定的重启参数
parameters.name: restart_app_param

parameters.help_en:
The list of compatible device models for the application version.

Format: `deviceModelId|minOsVersion|maxOsVersion`, which represents device model ID|minimum OS version|maximum OS version
parameters.help_zh:
应用版本的适配机型列表。

格式为：`deviceModelId|minOsVersion|maxOsVersion`，即设备型号ID|最低的系统版本号|最高的系统版本号
parameters.name: device_adapter_list

parameters.help_en: The version ID
parameters.name: version_id

parameters.help_en: The MD5 value of the APK
parameters.name: apk_md5
